items.prompt: Which event was successfully hosted by the city of Delhi in 2023?

items.question: What is Mumbai also known for?
items.answer: Mumbai is also known as the entertainment and business capital of India.

items.question: List (a) any five places of tourist interest in Delhi (b) two government offices located in Delhi.
answer: (a) Red Fort, India Gate, Qutub Minar, Jantar Mantar, Nehru Planetarium

items.question: What are embassies?
items.answer: The governments of other countries have offices in Delhi. These foreign offices are called Embassies or High Commissions.

items.question: List any five tourist spots of Mumbai.
items.answer: Gateway of India, Jehangir Art Gallery, Marine Drive, Taraporewala Aquarium, Essel World.

items.question: Why is New Delhi often referred to as 'Lutyens' Delhi'?
items.answer: The city of Delhi was planned and designed by British architect Sir Edwin Lutyens. Therefore, it is often referred to as 'Lutyens' Delhi'.

items.question: Why is Mumbai called the 'City of Dreams'?
items.answer: People from all over India come to Mumbai for employment or to become actors. It is home to many television and film stars, so Mumbai is called the City of Dreams.

items.question: Describe the climate of Delhi.
items.answer: The climate of Delhi is extreme. It has very hot summers. Hot and dry winds called loo blow from April to June. The winters are very cold, and it rains from July to September.

items.question: Write a short note on the transport system of Mumbai.
answer: Local train networks connect the city very well and it is the best public transport system in Mumbai.
The city also has one of the busiest railway stations in India — the Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus (CST).

items.question: What makes Delhi a well-connected city?
answer: Well-developed modern roads, bridges and flyovers have made Delhi a modern and comfortable city to live in.
Delhi Metro provides a fast and cheap means of transport to the people.

items.question: Why do you think Delhi is called a 'Mini India'?
answer: Delhi is famous for job opportunities and education, so people from different states come here.
Many universities in Delhi are great centres of learning and higher education; students from all over the world come to study here.

items.question: Why do you think Bombay High is of great importance?
items.answer: Bombay High is an important place because mineral oil is found here in the seabed. This mineral oil is purified in a refinery.

items.question: Kanika lives in Mumbai. What kind of clothes do you think she wears in (a) summer (b) winter?
answer: Summer in Mumbai is warm and humid, so Kanika wears light, cotton clothes.
Winters are not very cold but pleasant, so she wears light but warm clothes.
